df_issue_2.defect_as_recorded: equal available_time/vintage with differing content may not silently choose by later retrieval timestamp
df_issue_2.finding: DEFECT CONFIRMED LIVE AT PIN (initial intake assumption of present-at-pin protection was WRONG and was corrected by the characterization test): vintage_rank included retrieved_time_utc, so equal-vintage records with different retrieval times received different ranks; the AmbiguousVintageError guard never fired and select_asof silently preferred the later pull; VintageSeries.append silently accepted the conflicting revision. The pin's own test only covered the equal-retrieval corner.
df_issue_2.fix: new pit_rank(available, vintage) is the semantic conflict identity; both select_asof same-rank detection and VintageSeries.append now compare pit_rank and fail closed with AMBIGUOUS_VINTAGE_RANK regardless of retrieval order; retrieved_time survives only as a post-guard ordering tie-break; a preregistered authoritative revision key remains a future explicit extension
df_issue_2.tests: test_df_issue2_later_retrieval_never_silently_resolves_equal_rank (both retrieval orders refuse) + test_df_issue2_append_refuses_later_pull_with_different_content; DF suite 206 passed post-fix (204 at pin + 2)
df_issue_2.attribution: original audited semantics preserved at pin c6a0576; fix documented in pit_rank docstring
